accessNotes: The EUI docs site is JS-rendered (old #/elastic-charts/creating-charts route is gone); its source MDX was read from the elastic/eui GitHub repo (packages/website/docs/dataviz: overview and dashboard good practices). Exact theme values come from the elastic-charts LIGHT_THEME source (current default, Borealis) and EUI Borealis vis-colour tokens. Reference images are elastic-charts visual-regression baselines (rendered in CI, so the font fell back to a Helvetica/Arial-like sans instead of Inter). sizing.mdx, theming.mdx and per-chart-type pages were not read in detail.
summary: Elastic Charts is the dataviz system behind Kibana dashboards: dense, time-series-first product-UI charts that must look consistent with EUI. The default Borealis theme is light and cool: Inter font, 10px blue-grey tick labels, full horizontal AND vertical 1px gridlines in #E3E8F2, no tick marks, thin 1.5px lines, translucent (20%) area fills, a right-hand legend with circle swatches and values, and a paired 10-colour colour-blind-safe palette (teal, blue, pink, red, yellow each in strong + light).

colors.categoricalNotes: Borealis euiPaletteColorBlind = euiColorVis0-9: accentSecondary60 #16C5C0, accentSecondary30 #A6EDEA, primary60 #61A2FF, primary30 #BFDBFF, accent60 #EE72A6, accent30 #FFC7DB, danger60 #F6726A, danger30 #FFC9C2, warning60 #EAAE01, warning30 #FCD883 - i.e. five hues each as a strong/light pair. defaultVizColor (single series) = #16C5C0. Text-safe variants (euiColorVisText0-9) exist for labels. 'Use a neutral color for generic elements and an accent one for the things that you are looking for.' For custom brands 'pick really few colors'.
colors.notes: Sequential = euiColorVisCool0-2 (primary10/40/60); warm = euiColorVisWarm0-2 danger10 #FFF3F1, danger40 #FFB5AD, danger60 #F6726A; diverging listed is euiColorVisComplementary0/1 (primary60 #61A2FF vs warning60 #EAAE01). Status: success60 #24C292, warning60 #EAAE01, risk60 #FC8544, danger60 #F6726A, neutral60 #37B8DC. Greys: euiColorVisGrey0-3 = blueGrey30 #CAD3E2, blueGrey60 #8E9FBC, blueGrey90 #5A6D8C, blueGrey130 #1D2A3E; euiColorVisBase0 #F6F9FC. Missing-data colour = red keyword. Dimmed (unhighlighted) series opacity 0.25. Crosshair line uses borderStrongPrimary #0B64DD dashed [4,4]; crosshair band fill rgba(23,80,186,0.04). Dark theme: background blueGrey140 #111C2C, gridlines blueGrey120 #2B394F, text #CAD3E2.

axisTitle.placement: y title rotated 90° left of axis; x title centred below; 10px inner padding

typography.notes: Axis title fill textParagraph #1D2A3E; tick labels textSubdued #516381 at 10px, no rotation by default, padding inner 10/outer 8, single line. Bar value labels 10px centred in the bar. Goal/gauge labels #343741 / #646a77. Panel axis titles 10px sans-serif. Chart titles are normally provided by the Kibana panel, not the chart.

structure.gridlines: Both horizontal and vertical gridlines visible by default, solid 1px #E3E8F2 (borderBaseSubdued), opacity 1.
structure.axisLine: Axis lines visible, 1px #E3E8F2 (same light tone as gridlines).
structure.yAxisTitle: rotated, bold, left of tick labels (e.g. 'System Load')
structure.unitPlacement: In tick label formatting (e.g. 30%, 60.00) and axis title.
structure.frame: No plot border; chart sits in a Kibana/EUI panel on dashboards (panel margins recommended).
structure.notes: Time axis is two-level: fine time buckets (11:00, 11:05) on the first row with a context row below (date 'March 1, 2019'); time labels sit just right of their gridline, categorical labels are centred on their element. chartMargins and chartPaddings default to 0.

legend.placement: right (vertical, 200px wide) by default; can be top/bottom (horizontal height 64px)
legend.title: no
legend.notes: Legend rows show swatch, series name and optional current/last value right-aligned. Labels max 1 line, width limit 250px. Legend can be removed when colours match adjacent metric charts.

marks.bars: barsPadding 0.25 (bar gap = 25% of band); histogram padding 0.05; no border; flat corners.
marks.lines: strokeWidth 1.5 (2.5 when focused, 1 when dimmed); points 'auto' visibility with radius 3, white fill and series-colour 1.5px stroke, hidden when closer than 20px; no smoothing by default; fit lines dashed [5,5].
marks.areas: Fill opacity 0.2 under a 1.5px series-colour line; no points; fit area opacity 0.15.
marks.points: Bubble points radius 2, filled, no stroke.
marks.pies: Partition charts (pie/donut/treemap/sunburst/mosaic) supported; arcs separated by 1px stroke; label hierarchy reinforces name before value.
marks.notes: Unhighlighted series opacity 0.25 while another is hovered.

labels.dataLabels: Optional bar value labels, 10px, centred, no text border.
labels.numberFormat: Formatter-driven; examples show 2-decimal ticks (60.00) and integer percents (30%).
labels.dates: Time axis 'HH:mm' with a second-level date row ('March 1, 2019'); timestamps auto-converted to human units.

furniture.title: Remove unnecessary or repetitive titles (e.g. on Metric charts); when needed, make titles self-explanatory so axis titles can be removed. Metric and Bullet charts include their own title/subtitle.
furniture.other: Dashboard panels separated by margins; rows group related charts.

annotations: Line and rect annotations supported (storybook 'annotations-lines'); style not specified in guidance read.
layout: Prefer horizontal (wide) proportions for time series; avoid too narrow/short charts; scatterplots may be square. Important charts at the top of dashboards, increasing detail downward; large central chart as focal point; charts in rows; always use panel margins. Responsive: charts can switch to simpler models when too small (e.g. bullet to metric), with title truncation.
interaction: Crosshair: vertical dashed [4,4] 1px #0B64DD line plus faint blue band over the hovered bucket; tooltip shows all series values; hovering a legend item highlights its series and dims others to 25% opacity; focused line stroke grows to 2.5px. Dark theme available.
accessibility: Default palette is the colour-blind-safe euiPaletteColorBlind, 'tested for accessibility contrast'; text variants of vis colours for labels on backgrounds; dedicated 'accessibility features' page (texture fills supported via theme texture options).

discouraged: Area charts for very small numbers (use stacked bars)
chartTypes.notes: Most Kibana charts are time-based; pick the chart model by the feature it implies.

distinctiveRules.rule: Default categorical palette is 10 colours in strong/light pairs: #16C5C0, #A6EDEA, #61A2FF, #BFDBFF, #EE72A6, #FFC7DB, #F6726A, #FFC9C2, #EAAE01, #FCD883; single series uses #16C5C0.
Both horizontal and vertical gridlines on by default, solid 1px #E3E8F2; axis lines same colour; no tick marks.
distinctiveRules.quote: gridLine: { horizontal: { visible: true, stroke: borderBaseSubdued ... }, vertical: { visible: true ...} }, tickLine: { visible: false }

distinctiveRules.rule: Tick labels 10px Inter in blue-grey #516381; axis titles 12px in #1D2A3E (rendered bold), y title rotated.
distinctiveRules.quote: tickLabel: { fontSize: 10, fill: LIGHT_TEXT_COLORS.textSubdued }, axisTitle: { fontSize: 12, fill: textParagraph }

distinctiveRules.rule: Lines are thin (1.5px) with hollow white-filled 3px-radius points shown only when points are >=20px apart.
distinctiveRules.quote: strokeWidth: 1.5 ... point: { visible: 'auto', fill: backgroundBasePlain, radius: 3 }, pointVisibilityMinDistance: 20

distinctiveRules.rule: Area fills are 20% opacity of the series colour beneath a solid 1.5px line.
Bars take 75% of the band (barsPadding 0.25); histograms nearly touch (padding 0.05).
Legend on the right, 200px wide, circle swatches, series name plus current value, one line per item.
distinctiveRules.quote: legend: { verticalWidth: 200 ... labelOptions: { maxLines: 1 } } (circles observed in baseline images)

distinctiveRules.rule: Two-level time axis: time labels left-aligned just right of their gridline, with a second row giving the date context.
distinctiveRules.quote: Labels that describe passage of time ... are always positioned right next to the gridlines ... Our axes are based on a two-levels organization

distinctiveRules.rule: Categorical axis labels are centred on their element.
distinctiveRules.quote: Categorical labels ... are always centered on the element

distinctiveRules.rule: Hover dims non-highlighted series to 25% opacity; crosshair is a dashed [4,4] blue (#0B64DD) line with a faint band.
distinctiveRules.quote: unhighlighted: { opacity: 0.25 } ... crosshair line dash: [4, 4], stroke borderStrongPrimary

distinctiveRules.rule: Zero chart margins/paddings: the plot fills the panel edge to edge.
Use a neutral colour for generic elements and one accent colour for the thing being looked for.
distinctiveRules.quote: Use a neutral color for generic elements and an accent one for the things that you are looking for.

distinctiveRules.rule: Drop redundant chart titles; when a title is used make it exhaustive so axis titles can be removed.
distinctiveRules.quote: when title is needed make it self explanatory and exhaustive, this way you will be able to remove axis titles

referenceImages.describes: Stacked area time series on white: three series teal #16C5C0 (bottom), light teal #A6EDEA, blue #61A2FF (top), each with a 1.5px line and ~20% translucent fill. Light blue-grey solid gridlines in both directions; no ticks. Y labels '0.00'-'60.00' small grey left; rotated bold dark y title 'System Load'; x labels 11:00-11:55 left-aligned just right of each vertical gridline with 'March 1, 2019' on a second row; bold x title 'timestamp per 1 minute' centred below. Legend top-right: circle swatches, names (15m, 5m, 1m) and values (10.63 ...). No chart title.

Multi-series line chart: thin unsmoothed lines teal #16C5C0, light teal #A6EDEA, blue #61A2FF, no point markers at this density. Full light grid (horizontal + vertical) in #E3E8F2; y ticks 0%-30% grey 10px; rotated bold 'System Load'; two-level time axis (11:00 ... 11:55 / March 1, 2019). Right legend with filled circle swatches, names 1m/5m/15m and right-aligned values (10%, 11%).
